Insights — Overview

Delivery was the top complaint driver in Jul '26 with 4,260 tickets (68.7% of that month's volume). Info

Monthly Analysis

Auto-generated from ticket data — compares the selected period to the one before it. Figures are wrt that period's total sales; drill-downs show the courier/warehouse/product driving most of a category's change. Root-cause context (e.g. a specific coupon bug) isn't captured in the data and is not inferred here.
